name: jr-cache-clock
description: A prompt-cache countdown above the prompt: how long the cache stays warm after Claude's last reply, going green to red, the last cache hit rate, and a toast 30 seconds before it goes cold.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: 5 for the default cache, 60 if your setup uses the one-hour cache.

warnBeforeExpiry.title: Warn before it goes cold
warnBeforeExpiry.description: A toast 30 seconds before the cache expires.
